skill.name: okx-dex-market
skill.description: Queries read-only OKX Onchain OS data for token markets, wallet performance, signals, social sentiment, and meme-token research. Supports live WebSocket monitoring and payment confirmation.
skill.summary: Research DEX markets, tokens, wallets, social activity, and live on-chain signals through Onchain OS.
skill.author: okx

security_audit.summary: Static review confirms one critical unattended installer instruction; the remaining 130 matches are documentation, placeholders, examples, or fixed references. Semantic review also found untrusted preflight instructions and unvalidated payment fields entering CLI commands. Publication should remain blocked until remote execution and command construction are hardened.

remediation.issue: The missing-CLI fallback executes installer commands copied from a mutable remote README.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval, pin the installer to an immutable release, and verify a published checksum before execution.

remediation.issue: A non-null preflight data.action value is treated as an instruction to execute.
remediation.suggestion: Replace free-form actions with an allowlisted enum and fixed local handlers. Display unknown values as untrusted text without acting on them.

remediation.issue: External payment fields are inserted into executable CLI arguments without defined validation.
remediation.suggestion: Validate assets, chain identifiers, tiers, and names against strict schemas. Invoke the CLI with a structured argument array, never through shell interpolation.

content.user_title: Analyze On-Chain DEX Markets and Signals
content.value_statement: DEX research often requires several data sources and command formats. This skill routes read-only market, token, wallet, social, and live signal queries through Onchain OS.
actual_capabilities: Searches tokens and reports metadata, prices, liquidity, holders, clusters, trades, and top traders.
Retrieves spot prices, candlesticks, index prices, wallet performance, and DEX transaction history.
Tracks smart-money, influencer, whale, and custom-wallet activity across supported chains.
Summarizes crypto news, sentiment rankings, token interest, and relevant influencer activity.
Researches meme-token launches, developer history, bundles, snipers, and related wallets.
Starts, polls, and stops supported real-time WebSocket monitoring channels.
limitations: The skill provides research data and does not execute token purchases, swaps, sales, or sniping.
Results depend on Onchain OS availability, supported regions, chains, endpoints, and current API coverage.
Some endpoints require OKX credentials or payment after the free quota is exhausted.
Market signals, social sentiment, and token risk metadata are informational and do not guarantee outcomes.

use_cases.title: Compare Token Markets
use_cases.description: Review prices, liquidity, holders, and recent trades before deeper research.

use_cases.title: Monitor Wallet Activity
use_cases.description: Track smart-money transactions, wallet performance, and token-level profit or loss.

use_cases.title: Screen New Meme Tokens
use_cases.description: Evaluate launches, developer history, holder concentration, bundles, and sniper activity.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Token Price
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the current price of [token address] on [chain], including the data timestamp.

prompt_templates.title: Research a Token
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [token address] on [chain] using liquidity, holders, recent trades, risk metadata, and social sentiment.

prompt_templates.title: Review Wallet Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize wallet [address] on [chain] for [period], including realized profit, win rate, recent trades, and leading tokens.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Live Signal Monitor
prompt_templates.prompt: Monitor [chains] for [signal types], filter by [criteria], and summarize new events with timestamps and contract addresses.

output_examples.input: Compare current prices for three specified Ethereum tokens.
output_examples.output: A compact comparison lists each token, USD price, request time, and any unavailable result. Contract addresses distinguish tokens with similar symbols.

output_examples.input: Review a wallet's seven-day DEX performance.
output_examples.output: The report summarizes realized profit, win rate, transaction activity, and strongest token results for the requested period.

output_examples.input: Screen a newly launched Solana meme token.
output_examples.output: The assessment highlights liquidity, holder concentration, developer history, bundle activity, sniper indicators, and important data gaps.

best_practices: Provide the chain and lowercase contract address whenever possible.
Treat market, social, and wallet data as time-sensitive research rather than financial advice.
Review payment details and explicitly confirm or cancel before any paid retry.
anti_patterns: Do not request purchases, swaps, sales, or token sniping through this read-only skill.
Do not identify a token by symbol alone when several contracts share that symbol.
Do not treat smart-money signals, sentiment, or historical performance as guaranteed returns.

faq.question: Can this skill trade tokens?
faq.answer: No. It performs read-only research and routes write requests to a separate discovery workflow.

faq.question: Which data can it retrieve?
faq.answer: It covers token, market, wallet, signal, social, meme-token, and supported WebSocket data.

faq.question: Does it require an OKX account?
faq.answer: Some public queries may work directly. Authenticated WebSocket or payment-gated endpoints require configured OKX credentials.

faq.question: Can it monitor markets in real time?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use supported Onchain OS WebSocket channels for prices, candles, trades, signals, and launches.

faq.question: Will every query be free?
faq.answer: No. Some endpoints may require payment after monthly free quotas are exhausted, and the skill must request confirmation.

faq.question: Does token risk metadata prove a token is safe?
faq.answer: No. Risk fields and historical patterns support research, but they cannot eliminate contract, liquidity, market, or fraud risk.
